package.name: OpenCabinetEngine
package.description: Structurally verified wardrobe generation inside FreeCAD. Simplified task-panel inputs (width/height/depth/bays/per-bay function); column widths are solved automatically so door seams land exactly on partition centers; the opencabinet deterministic solver enforces hard gates (zero interference, closed dimension chains) before any board is created, and back-panel grooves are cut into the solids.
